a_cell_contrast.rule: glass mean luminance occupied / the BRIGHTEST single empty cell of the same ring (each skin-probe cell and each empty cell on the plate) >= 3.0, per ring and per covered sector; live and dying units gated (dimmed = hover dim, ghosts: reported); marks, token disc, HP tray and tracers cut out.  The Adjuster HP track: 0 px under its diamond plate or the guns layer

room_ref.source: ring NOW occupied glass p95 (live cells)

b_value_order.rule: p95 L* per family region; A.1 chain SEND IT > T HOT marks > P tower > P hand (rest) > E cells occupied (glass) > E cells empty (glass); K below the tower, K median in L* 45-55; token discs below HOT marks; every E / K / T / N mark class (HP ticks, Adjuster HP and plate, badges, sector digits, ring tags, bezel labels, tickets, token discs, COLD, FAR, plan): p99 at least 1 under the HOT p95, and every E / K mark p95 at least 1 under the tower p95; room (x >= 1100, y >= 420, r > 505, UI / hand / hover tag and the UI scrim slabs cut out) mean L* 28-34 with its p95 below the ring-NOW occupied glass p95 (live cells; L* 40 when no ring-NOW cell is live)

round2.rule: C3: every pixel inside r < 480 at L* >= 80 sits in a capture class (1 px dilation); structure rows p99 >= 1 under the HOT p95 (no class but SEND IT reaches the HOT marks), E / K p95 >= 1 under the tower p95.  C4: each token disc p95 >= 1 under the HOT p95 and the tower p95

parked.note: designer note 8 (VISUAL_PLAN, Parked): hover_tag keeps its E10 form and content; reported, not gated

c_cap_height.rule: cap height (font H box x px) of every text draw >= 16 px at 1080p; card text at the hand scale; the parked hover tag text is reported, not gated; any text drawn outside the hooked drawers fails the check

d_palette.rule: dE76 >= 15: token pairs; slice inks, card type plates, skin hue inks vs the tokens they sit next to; HOT / COLD marks vs the measured cell colours

round2.rule: C2: the drawn colour of FOCUS / HOT fill / gun tracers / Adjuster track (the modal colour of its chromatic pixels, C* > 25: keylines and the white-hot core drop out) and of the pencil wax (its brightest tenth: the grain only darkens) within dE76 3 of its token, the plain modal reported beside it; every drawn mark class (same measure) >= 15 from the skin hue inks.  C16: the Solace rim (r 491-498) >= 25 from GAIN and the hub HP green

e_hand.rule: hand pixels under SEND IT / UNDO: 0; lifted card (its alpha >= 128: card, pink print, hard drop) over a sibling card cost hex, title band, rules line or multiplier plate: 0 px

f_pencil.rule: C1 on the plate: wax width 6-8 px, ink edge 2.4-3.6 px per side, wax grain L* std >= 2.0 (wax = within dE 30 of PLAN, ink = L* < 30, inside the pencil classes; widths from the medial axis)

g_tickets.rule: C5: each ticket edge L* (p90 of the 3 px ring inside the keyline); the W6 / W5 / W4 edges differ step to step by >= 5 L*; the W6 hazard ticks sit in the top row (tag to turn pips), clear of the bomb glyph and its width pips

stage2_rule: 2.7: hand bottom (alpha >= 128) at least 12 px above y = 1080; 2.14: every kind glyph on the three wave tickets has an ink height of 16 px or more and p90 L* within 4 of the K type value (L* 84, the same full value on every ticket; time is on the ticket edge and pips)
